topics.title: Something changed in my life
topics.question: Something changed in my life
topics.label: Something changed in my life
topics.prompt: The employee has had a life change. Ask which one (new baby or adoption, marriage, divorce, new dependent, losing coverage elsewhere, turning 65, retiring) before explaining what they can update and by when.
topics.notes: Routes into the life-event set below

topics.title: Help me choose a medical plan
topics.question: Help me choose a medical plan
topics.label: Help me choose a medical plan
topics.prompt: Help the employee compare our medical plans. First ask about coverage tier (just me, me + spouse, me + children, family) and expected care this year (mostly preventive, some visits, ongoing condition or planned procedure). Then compare premiums, deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums for that situation.
topics.notes: Need to update with new year’s plan data once we get it

topics.title: Explain my FSA or HSA
topics.question: Explain my FSA or HSA
topics.label: Explain my FSA or HSA
topics.prompt: Explain the health spending accounts we offer, how each works, and which one fits the employee's medical plan. Ask which plan they are on if it matters.

topics.title: What's covered for dental and vision?
topics.question: What's covered for dental and vision?
topics.label: What's covered for dental and vision?
topics.prompt: Summarize our dental and vision plan coverage, including preventive care, common procedures, and frequency limits.

topics.title: Talk to a benefits person
topics.question: Talk to a benefits person
topics.label: Talk to a benefits person
topics.prompt: Give the employee the contact options for the benefits team and what to have ready when they call.
topics.notes: I believe we will have HR on hand to help (not chat) and perhaps benefits advisors too -  I need to get you this info

quickQuestions: I just had a baby. What do I need to do?
What is the difference between an HRA and an HSA?
Does the vision plan cover eye exams?
lifeEventPromptEnding: State the deadline for making changes, and offer the benefits contact.

lifeEventPills.label: I'm having or adopting a baby
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain what the employee should do for a birth or adoption: adding the child to medical, dental and vision, the deadline, dependent care FSA, life insurance beneficiaries, and leave.
lifeEventPills.benefitsTouched: Medical, dental, vision, FSA, life, leave

lifeEventPills.label: I'm getting married
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain adding a spouse to coverage, the deadline, documents needed, and updating beneficiaries and tax withholding.

lifeEventPills.label: I'm going through a divorce
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain removing a spouse from coverage, the deadline, what happens to their coverage, and updating beneficiaries. Keep a neutral, practical tone.

lifeEventPills.label: My child is turning 26
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain when a dependent loses coverage at 26, the date coverage ends, and the options available to them afterward.

lifeEventPills.label: Am I ready for Medicare?
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain how Medicare works alongside our coverage for an active employee approaching 65, enrollment timing, and how Medicare enrollment affects HSA contributions. Recommend confirming personal decisions with the benefits team or Social Security.
lifeEventPills.audienceRule: Age 63+ if known; else on request

lifeEventPills.label: I'm thinking about retiring
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain what happens to each benefit at retirement, any retiree coverage, conversion or portability options for life insurance, and Medicare timing if relevant.

lifeEventPills.label: I just started here
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain the new-hire enrollment window and deadline, what happens if they miss it, and the main choices to make.
lifeEventPills.audienceRule: Tenure under 30 days – may need to ask this

lifeEventPills.label: I lost other coverage
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain how losing coverage elsewhere (a spouse's plan, for example) lets the employee enroll mid-year, and the deadline.

lifeEventPills.label: Someone in my family died
lifeEventPills.prompt: Explain, gently and briefly, how to file a life insurance claim, update coverage for remaining dependents, and reach support such as the EAP. Lead with the benefits contact.

decisionExplainerPills.label: Which plan costs less for me?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Ask coverage tier and expected care, then estimate total yearly cost (premiums plus likely out-of-pocket) for each plan, showing the math and assumptions.

decisionExplainerPills.label: Is a high-deductible plan right for me?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain the trade-off of a lower premium for a higher deductible plus HSA. Ask about expected care and comfort with upfront costs.

decisionExplainerPills.label: HSA vs. FSA: what's the difference?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Compare ownership, rollover, contribution limits for the current plan year, eligibility, and what each can pay for.

decisionExplainerPills.label: What can I buy with my FSA?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain eligible expense categories with common examples and how to submit claims.

decisionExplainerPills.label: How does dependent care FSA work?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain eligible care, the annual limit, and how reimbursement works.

decisionExplainerPills.label: What's a deductible vs. out-of-pocket max?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain deductible, copay, coinsurance and out-of-pocket maximum using a simple worked example.

decisionExplainerPills.label: Is my doctor in network?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain how to check network status with each carrier's provider search, and what happens out of network. Do not guess whether a specific provider is in network.

decisionExplainerPills.label: How much life insurance do I have?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain basic life coverage we provide and any supplemental options. Do not state the employee's personal amount unless enrollment data is connected.

decisionExplainerPills.label: What does disability insurance cover?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain short- and long-term disability: when it starts, how much it pays, and how to file.

decisionExplainerPills.label: Does vision cover contacts?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: Explain the vision allowance for frames, lenses and contacts, and frequency limits.

decisionExplainerPills.label: What extra benefits do we have?
decisionExplainerPills.prompt: List voluntary and wellbeing benefits (EAP, and others in the knowledge base) in one line each, and offer to go deeper on any.

seasonalPills.label: What's changing for next year?
seasonalPills.prompt: Summarize what changed in our benefits for the coming plan year: premiums, plan design, new or removed options. Use only next-year documents.

seasonalPills.label: Do I need to do anything this enrollment?
seasonalPills.prompt: Explain what happens if the employee does nothing (which elections roll over and which, like FSA, must be re-elected), and the deadline.

seasonalPills.label: How much should I put in my FSA?
seasonalPills.prompt: Help estimate a contribution: ask about predictable expenses (prescriptions, glasses, planned dental work), then explain the use-it-or-lose-it rule and our carryover or grace period.

seasonalPills.label: I still have FSA money left
seasonalPills.prompt: Explain the deadline to spend or claim, our grace period or carryover, and eligible purchases.

seasonalPills.label: Where are my tax forms?
seasonalPills.prompt: Explain which benefits-related tax forms the employee may receive (W-2 codes, Form 1095, HSA Forms 1099-SA and 5498-SA), when, and where to find them.

seasonalPills.label: How do HSA contributions affect my taxes?
seasonalPills.prompt: Explain the tax treatment of HSA contributions, the prior-year contribution deadline, and recommend a tax professional for personal situations.
